description: CFTC Commitments-of-Traders positioning for THREE curated markets (keys gold, crude_oil, sp500). Pass `market` for its weekly history, NEWEST FIRST (names are normalised: 'wti', 'GOLD', 'e-mini s&p' resolve), or omit it for the latest report across the three. Returns {summary, market, matched_market, rows}. mm_* and open_interest are CONTRACT counts, not dollars, and mm_* cover ONE speculative category per report family (Managed Money for gold and crude_oil, Leveraged Funds for sp500). `limit` (series only) default 52, hard cap 156. An unreachable store is REFUSED (DATA_UNAVAILABLE). Source: CFTC.gov (public domain); FREE. ATTRIBUTION: every field is CFTC verbatim EXCEPT market_key and market_label (Oxford Ledge's curated market catalog) and mm_net (mm_long minus mm_short, computed by Oxford Ledge). Caveats ride the response's tool_notes.

limit.description: Weekly reports for a market series (default 52, hard cap 156).

market.description: Market key, CFTC report name or desk symbol -- gold / GC / XAU, crude_oil / CL / WTI, sp500 / ES / S&P (case-insensitive; omit for the latest all-market snapshot).
